In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an advertiser can put XML syntax in fields of its own video creative. Unescaped MediaFile attributes and CDATA terminators allow the advertiser to inject elements into VAST responses served for a publisher's zone. A crafted TrackingEvents block can suppress the ad server's video playback event records and redirect tracking requests to an attacker-controlled endpoint. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 4.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:N/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 4.10 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause reflected cross-site scripting. A crafted delivery URL places a macro token in the source or target parameter and malicious markup in the referer parameter. Macro replacement after initial input encoding can insert the unescaped markup into generated banner output, causing JavaScript execution in the delivery origin when a visitor follows the URL. An active banner is required. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.10 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 3.10 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) LOW

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone banner-linking page (zone-include.php) does not cast the keys of the includebanner request array to integers. An authenticated manager, or a trafficker with the zone-linking permission, who owns the submitted website and zone can place SQL in an array key, which is concatenated unquoted into the banner-lookup query, resulting in time-based blind SQL injection bounded by the privileges of the application's database account. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the ct0 request parameter of the delivery scripts is only required to start with http:// or https:// and is prepended unescaped to banner click URLs. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a delivery URL that executes JavaScript in the delivery origin when a visitor follows it. An active banner using the raw {clickurl} macro is required. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 4.70 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager with access to two advertisers can associate a conversion tracker owned by one advertiser with a campaign owned by the other. The tracker-campaign page checks access to each object but does not verify that their actual owners match. The resulting association can expose the first advertiser's tracker name and identifier in the second advertiser's restricted conversion report. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the public conversion-variable endpoint does not verify that a caller-supplied conversion belongs to the supplied tracker. An unauthenticated attacker can submit a unique variable for a different tracker's conversion, causing that conversion to be classified as a duplicate and excluded from conversion reports. 26/11/2026 26/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM
